ModMetaData.name: Agent Translation Bridge
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Agent Translation
ModMetaData.description:
Optional companion of the Agent Translation pack (rwat).
Settings page with a simple mode (how-to, translation status, pack language) and an advanced mode (all options and the full report). Open it from Options > Mod settings, the bottom-right icon row (needs Harmony) or the small tab button in the bottom bar; both buttons can be hidden.
Reports which pack translations are actually in effect in the game (and which ones another mod overrides), and can reload Keyed translations without restarting (experimental, off by default).
Reads and writes only its own folder AgentTranslation inside the game's data folder (next to Saves and Config). Opens no network port. Never changes other mods. Harmony is optional: without it only the bottom-right icon is unavailable.
